 This Appeal, Coming On For Hearing, This Day, The
Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment
Learned counsel for the appellant has filed a memo seeking withdrawal of the appeal with a liberty to file claim petition under Motor Vehicles Act before the competent Tribunal.
The memo is placed on record.
Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed as not pressed with liberty as prayed for in the memo.
